deepdive.divline: Strict ROCE threshold for investments; No new major capex beyond current pipeline (Lines 3/4/5, PET) for next 12-18 months; Focus on deleveraging from FY28 to achieve net debt zero by FY30

profile.entities: Jubilant Pharmova Ltd; Jubilant Radiopharma; CDMO Sterile Injectables (Spokane/Montreal)
profile.subseg: Radiopharmaceuticals (SPECT/PET); CDMO Sterile Injectables; Allergy Immunotherapy; Generics; CRDMO
profile.themes: Montreal Capacity Ramp; Line 3 Biologics Commercialization; SPECT Supply Constraints; MIBG NDA Filing

bull_bear.body: Strict ROCE threshold for investments; No new major capex beyond current pipeline (Lines 3/4/5, PET) for next 12-18 months; Focus on deleveraging from FY28 to achieve net debt zero by FY30.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Montreal ramp-up delays extending losses beyond FY28; Regulatory delays in MIBG NDA or PET pharmacy approvals; Sustained SPECT supply chain disruptions; High interest/depreciation burden suppressing PAT.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Cautiously optimistic; Transparent about near-term margin headwinds (H1FY27) but confident in H2 recovery and long-term ROCE from biologics/radiopharma assets.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Montreal losses expected to persist at ~Rs.200 Cr run-rate in FY27 before meaningful reduction in FY28; MIBG priority review voucher status uncertain due to predecessor product (Azedra) history; Ruby-Fill operates on a razor-blade annuity model with 6-7 week replacement cycles.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Radiopharma: Margin pressure in H1FY27 due to $14mn SPECT revenue miss; CDMO: Line 3 tech transfer revenue $60-80mn expected in FY27; Allergy: 90% US exposure, growing via share gains & non-US expansion; Generics: Margins expanded to double digits.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supply shortage of SPECT products and Montreal under-absorption compressing near-term margins | Dr. Reddy's Laboratories | beneficiary | Low | Potential alternative supplier for SPECT components if Jubilant supply remains constrained, though direct overlap is limited. |
| High switching costs and stringent aseptic requirements for complex biologics creating durable CDMO relationships | Divi's Laboratories | beneficiary | Med | Sector-wide tailwind for Indian CDMOs securing complex biologic contracts; validates premium pricing power in sterile injectables. |
| Delays in Montreal profitability and high capex cycle delaying free cash flow generation | Jubilant Pharmova Ltd | loser | High | Self-inflicted near-term pain from Montreal ramp-up and SPECT supply issues delaying margin expansion and deleveraging. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body: Q4 Margin 15.7% impacted by Montreal under-absorption and SPECT supply gap; FY27 H1 margins temporarily depressed; H2FY27 margins guided to 17-18% as Montreal stabilizes and Line 3 absorbs costs.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: FY27 Revenue: Low double-digit growth; FY27 Margins: H1 pressured (SPECT shortage), H2 recovery to 17-18%; Order Inflow: Line 3 commercial start late FY27; Capex: ~Rs.1,668 Cr (similar to FY26) for Line 4, Line 5, PET pharmacies.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: 10+ products in tech transfer for Line 3 (80% complex biologics including major oncology asset); Commercial production expected late FY27; Peak revenue for Line 3 projected at $80-90mn.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: MIBG NDA filing H2FY27 (accelerated review expected); Ruby-Fill annuity model (30%+ growth); PET pharmacy network commercialization starting FY27; European expansion in Allergy.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Jubilant Pharmova delivered 19% Q4 revenue growth driven by Radiopharma and CDMO, but EBITDA margins compressed to 15.7% due to Montreal under-absorption and SPECT supply shortages. The investment thesis hinges on H2FY27 margin recovery as Montreal stabilizes and Line 3 (Spokane) begins commercial production of high-margin biologics, targeting $80-90mn peak revenue.
